content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Madras University Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: http://www.unom.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Madras University for filling up various administrative and academic positions including the Controller of Examinations.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available across different posts including Controller of Examinations, Professor cum Director, and Dean-College Development Council.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for Madras University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through offline mode by downloading the application form from the official website and sending the filled copies via post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the offline application?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of filled-in applications at the university is 16 October 2026. Make sure your application reaches before this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for the Controller of Examinations post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Master's degree with at least 55% marks along with 15 years of teaching, research, or administrative experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General category candidates is Rs. 500/-, while reserved categories like SC/ST have a reduced fee structure.

faq.question: Q7. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The filled applications along with 8 copies and required enclosures should be sent to the Convener, VC-Convener Committee, University of Madras, Chennai - 600 005.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for Level 14 posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for Level 14 posts will receive a salary ranging between Rs. 1,44,200/- and Rs. 2,18,200/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit relaxation provided?
faq.answer: Age limits are specified per post, with maximum age limits set at 55 and 57 years depending on the specific position applied for.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises initial application screening followed by an interview round for shortlisted candidates meeting all criteria.
